rule_text: grant delete on nodes (e:Event) where e.status = "critical" to alpha_SeniorDoctor;
deny create on nodes (p:Patient) where p.age < 18 to alpha_Intern;
grant modify{*} on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Intern;
grant create on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Intern;
grant traverse on nodes (p:Patient) where p.condition = "stable" to alpha_Intern;
deny delete on nodes (p:Patient) where p.status <> discharged or p.status = critical to alpha_Intern;
deny modify{condition} on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Intern;
deny modify{status} on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Intern;
deny modify{age} on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Intern;
grant delete on relationships (t:TREATS) where t.priority >= 5 to alpha_HeadPhysician;
grant add{*} on relationships (t:TREATS) to alpha_HeadPhysician;
grant traverse on relationships (t:TREATS) where t.status = "active" to alpha_HeadPhysician;
grant read{*} on relationships (t:TREATS) to alpha_HeadPhysician;
deny add{status} on relationships (t:TREATS) to alpha_HeadPhysician;
deny add{priority} on relationships (t:TREATS) to alpha_HeadPhysician;
grant modify{cost} on nodes (t:Treatment) to alpha_BillingManager;
grant delete on nodes (t:Treatment) where t.approved = "no" to alpha_BillingManager;
grant create on relationships (p:PRESCRIBES) where p.dosage > 500 to alpha_Doctor;
deny modify{dosage} on relationships (p:PRESCRIBES) to alpha_Doctor;
grant traverse on relationships (p:PRESCRIBES) where p.frequency = "daily" to alpha_Doctor;
grant modify{*} on relationships (p:PRESCRIBES) to alpha_Doctor;
deny modify{frequency} on relationships (p:PRESCRIBES) to alpha_Doctor;
deny modify{diagnosis} on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Nurse;
grant read{diagnosis} on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Nurse;
grant remove{diagnosis} on nodes (p:Patient) to alpha_Nurse;
deny modify{*} on nodes (m:MedicalRecord) to alpha_Intern;
grant remove{notes} on nodes (m:MedicalRecord) to alpha_Intern;
grant read{notes} on nodes (m:MedicalRecord) to alpha_Intern;
deny traverse on nodes (*) to alpha_MedicalSecretary;
grant traverse on nodes (m:MedicalRecord) to alpha_MedicalSecretary;
grant create on nodes (p:Patient) where p.age >= 65 to alpha_SeniorDoctor;
grant traverse on nodes (p:Patient) where p.age >= 0 to alpha_SeniorDoctor;
grant traverse on relationships (t:TREATS) where t.age >= 18 AND t.age <= 65 to alpha_DepartmentHead;
grant read{approval_status} on nodes (t:Treatment) to alpha_Nurse;
deny read{*} on nodes (t:Treatment) to alpha_Nurse;
grant create on relationships (r:WORKS_ON) where r.year > 2020 to alpha_Nurse;
grant traverse on relationships (r:WORKS_ON) where r.year > 2020 to alpha_Nurse;
grant create on nodes (e:Document) to alpha_Nurse;
grant traverse on nodes (e:Document) to alpha_Nurse;
deny traverse on nodes (e:Document) to alpha_Nurse;
deny create on nodes (e:Document) to alpha_Nurse;
